isothermal_open_hold.pressure_basis: Declared 1 bar ideal throughflow illustration; original experiment is atmospheric, not an exact recorded absolute pressure.
isothermal_open_hold.inventory_basis: Approximate measured aged-sample capacity in source cycle 45 at 630 C, borrowed as a declared common inventory for the four illustrative isothermal cases; not measured separately for every pressure and temperature.
isothermal_open_hold.state_basis: Isothermal, isobaric, zero gas accumulation; finite initial CaCO3/CaO inventories; no transient surface storage, no changing active area; well-swept ideal Ar/water carrier at the solid temperature.

joint_source_box_review.interpretation: Feasibility only within the rectangular printed parameter margins and all observation rectangles; data-constrained search using the original fitting data, not independent validation or a confidence region. Nominal prediction is retained unchanged.

scope: Fixed specimen plateau and conditional same-temperature net-reaction calorimeter; no intrinsic area scaling, inverse reaction or transient intermediate storage.
